procedure_text: 步骤a:取1.1mol(134.2g)三氟乙醇钠,1.2mol(166.8g)碳酸钾,1.0mol(318g)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯(化合物I),1000mL N,N-二甲基甲酰胺加入到反应器中,然后30℃保温5小时后,将反应液中的N,N-二甲基甲酰胺减压蒸除后,将残液加入300mL水中,用35％的盐酸调pH至弱酸性,冷却结晶,过滤,水洗,干燥得化合物II,称重得321.7g,收率93％。
procedure_summary: Sodium trifluoroethoxide displaces the benzylic bromide of the methylsulfonyl benzoate ester in N,N-dimethylformamide over a carbonate base at a mild held temperature. The solvent is stripped under reduced pressure, the residue taken into water and acidified, and the intermediate crystallised on cooling, filtered, washed with water and dried.

procedure_text: 步骤b:取1mol上述反应所得的化合物II,溶解在1000mL的环己烷中,然后在-10-8℃温度条件下,半小时内加入含1mol(98g)1,3-环己二酮(化合物III)和1mol(152g)缩合剂DBU以及1mol(152g)吡啶,再在-10-8℃温度条件下搅拌反应24小时,然后经过水洗、减压浓缩、加甲醇打浆、过滤、干燥得到成品环磺酮(化合物IV)332.9g,纯度94.6％,收率80.1％。
procedure_summary: The intermediate from the previous step is dissolved in cyclohexane and acylates cyclohexanedione at low temperature, with a condensing agent and pyridine added together over a short period. The mixture is stirred at the same temperature, then washed with water, concentrated under reduced pressure, slurried with methanol, filtered and dried to give the finished tembotrione.
